_meta.source: Financial Planner curated SG merchant list (repo). Your Drive merchants.json entries override these.

confidence.reported: Published by a named source (see source).
confidence.typical: Standard MCC for this kind of merchant in SG; not independently confirmed.
confidence.unverified: Best guess. Check your statement or HeyMax / DBS digibot and correct it.

_meta.howToCheck: HeyMax merchant search; or lock a DBS card and read the declined MCC in digibot; or the Instarem app with an Amaze-paired card.

merchants.name: Kopitiam
merchants.notes: Food court chain (FairPrice Group). Card terminals usually code as eating places.

merchants.name: Kopitiam
merchants.notes: Pay-in-app at ~70 Kopitiam outlets incl. Lau Pa Sat. Counts as an online/in-app payment. MCC not published — check the first statement line; if it shows as FAIRPRICE with 5411, change this entry.

merchants.name: Lau Pa Sat
merchants.notes: Run under Kopitiam/FairPrice Group. Paying via the FairPrice app → use the Kopitiam (via FairPrice Group app) entry.

merchants.name: Food Republic
merchants.notes: BreadTalk Group — Food Republic is not a yuu merchant.

merchants.name: Hawker stall (NETS/card terminal)
merchants.notes: Many hawker stalls use SGQR/NETS — not card payments.

merchants.name: Grab
merchants.notes: Excluded from rewards on almost every card.

merchants.name: foodpanda
merchants.notes: yuu merchant (DBS yuu 10 mpd if threshold met).

merchants.name: Shopee
merchants.notes: MoneySmart and The Money Bees: 5399 (some cards show 5331).

merchants.name: Taobao
merchants.notes: Website orders reported as 5411. Often FCY.

merchants.name: HeyMax
merchants.notes: Gift card purchases code as department store — popular for filling 4 mpd caps.

merchants.name: Ryde
merchants.notes: Codes as software (5734), not taxi — transport bonuses usually miss.

merchants.name: SPC
merchants.notes: Excluded on AMEX and UOB Visa Signature.

merchants.name: Singapore Airlines
merchants.notes: Airline MCCs are 3000–3350; SIA uses its own code in this range. AMEX KrisFlyer 2 mpd.

merchants.name: Anytime Fitness / Fitness First / Virgin Active
Enrichment / tuition classes
merchants.notes: Often excluded as education; some coding as recreation (7999) does earn.

merchants.name: CardUp
merchants.notes: Earns on DBS Altitude, UOB, AMEX; excluded on DBS WWMC, HSBC.
